Active members, appreciating the opportunities offered by membership are urged to pray for the missions and the missionaries and for all members of the Associa- tion; and to offer Holy Communion when they can for these inten- tions. Those who can afford to do so, are asked to contribute to the material support - usually 50c annually or $5. as a perpetual member - more if they wish and $2. or more a deceased member - - perpetuall membership or participation.
